title: Character
description: Defines a character with comprehensive narrative integration, LLM-GM guidance, and enhanced progression systems.

id.description: Unique, machine-readable ID for the character, e.g., 'character_luke_skywalker'.

name.description: The display name of the character.

era.description: The primary era this character is most associated with, e.g., 'Galactic_Republic', 'Galactic_Empire', 'New_Republic'.

rarity.description: How unique or special this character is in the galaxy.

narrative.description: Rich narrative description of the character, their role, and significance. Used by LLM-GM for storytelling.

flavor_text.description: Iconic quote or description that captures the essence of this character, often from Star Wars lore.

cultural_significance.description: Description of how this character is viewed by different cultures and groups in the galaxy.

description.description: Detailed mechanical and lore description of the character.

origin_story.description: The history and origin of this character in the galaxy.

species_id.description: ID of the species this character belongs to.

background_id.description: ID of the background this character has.

game_mode.description: The game mode settings for this character.

mode_id.description: The ID of the game mode being used.

xp_multiplier.description: Multiplier for XP gain for this character.

speed.description: The character's movement speed in feet.

proficiencies.description: List of proficiencies the character has.

languages.description: List of languages the character knows.

equipment.description: List of equipment the character has.

features.description: List of features the character has.

spells.description: List of spells the character knows.

moral_compass.description: Character's moral compass ranging from -100 (completely Dark) to +100 (completely Light). Default starting value is 0 (neutral).

properties.$comment: SECTION 4: TAGS & PHYSICAL PROFILE (Genesis Protocol Article II & VI)

tags.description: UNIVERSAL TAGGING SYSTEM: Tags are the fundamental vocabulary of the game. Every character has a tags block that is a living document containing both static tags (from Species, Class, Background, etc.) and dynamic tags (earned through gameplay, reputation, achievements). All tags must be defined in master_tags.yml.

physical_profile.description: ARTISANAL PERFECTION (Article VI-C): Physical characteristics for dynamic image generation. The engine combines this with species_id, class_id, inventory, and action context to create rich, contextualized image prompts at run-time.

hair_color.description: Hair color (or equivalent for non-human species).

distinguishing_features.description: Scars, tattoos, cybernetics, or other unique features. These can be added dynamically during gameplay.

typical_attire.description: Typical clothing and accessories when not in specific gear.

voice_description.description: Description of the character's voice for LLM-GM narration.

properties.$comment: MIGRATION NOTE: The 'connections' block is DEPRECATED per Genesis Protocol Article III. All connection-based synergies should be migrated to synergy_rules.yml using the tags system. This block is kept for backward compatibility during the migration period.

connections.description: DEPRECATED: Use tags and synergy_rules.yml instead. Universal connections to any game object - factions, species, classes, locations, etc.

target_id.description: ID of the target object (faction, species, class, location, etc.).

target_type.description: The type of object being connected to.

relationship.description: The nature of the relationship, e.g., 'Member Of', 'Enemy Of', 'Allied With', 'From'.

narrative.description: Description of how these objects are connected.

mechanical_benefit.description: Optional mechanical benefit from this connection.

iconic_examples.description: Famous or notable examples of this character type from Star Wars canon.

famous_characters.description: Notable characters of this type from Star Wars lore.

homeworld.description: The primary homeworld or origin of this character.

cultural_notes.description: Important cultural information about this character.

narrative_hooks.description: Story hooks and narrative elements specific to this character.

social_dynamics.description: How this character interacts with others in the galaxy.

common_motivations.description: Common motivations and goals for this character.

character_development.description: Guidance for character development and progression.

base_prompt.description: Base prompt for generating images of this character.

contextual_modifiers.description: Modifiers for different contexts and situations.

target_type.description: The type of image being generated (e.g., 'Portrait', 'Action_Shot', 'Character_Scene').

modifier_text.description: Additional text to add to the prompt for this context.

image.description: Path to the character image file.

icon.description: Path to the character icon file.

color.description: Primary color associated with this character for UI theming.
